INTERNAL MEMORANDUM

TO: All Staff – Marbledock & Associates
FROM: Office of the Managing Director
DATE: September 3, 2025
SUBJECT: Implementation of Revised Remote Work and Flexible Scheduling Policy

Dear Colleagues,

As we move into the final quarter of fiscal year 2025, Marbledock & Associates is pleased to announce the formal implementation of our updated Remote Work and Flexible Scheduling Policy, effective Monday, September 15, 2025.

Following an extensive review period that included feedback from department heads, the HR Committee, and a company-wide employee survey conducted in July 2025, the following key changes have been approved by senior leadership:

1. HYBRID WORK ARRANGEMENT
All full-time employees in eligible roles may work remotely up to three (3) days per week. Employees are required to be present in the office on Tuesdays and Wednesdays, which have been designated as mandatory in-office collaboration days. Exceptions must be approved in advance by the respective department director.

2. FLEXIBLE SCHEDULING WINDOWS
Core working hours are established between 10:00 AM and 3:00 PM local time, during which all team members must be available and reachable. Outside of these core hours, employees may adjust their start and end times within the window of 7:00 AM to 7:00 PM, provided a minimum of eight (8) hours of productive work is completed each day.

3. REMOTE WORK EQUIPMENT AND SECURITY PROTOCOLS
Employees working remotely must use company-issued devices exclusively for all work-related activities. Personal devices are not permitted for handling confidential client data or accessing internal systems. All remote connections must be established through the company's approved VPN. IT support is available Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM, for technical assistance.

4. COMMUNICATION AND AVAILABILITY STANDARDS
During core hours, all employees are expected to respond to internal communications (email, Teams, or phone) within thirty (30) minutes. Out-of-office notifications must be configured when an employee is unavailable for periods exceeding one (1) hour during their elected working hours.

5. PERFORMANCE AND ACCOUNTABILITY
Department managers will conduct monthly check-ins to assess productivity, team cohesion, and policy compliance. Continued eligibility for remote work privileges is contingent upon meeting established performance benchmarks and adhering to the terms outlined in this policy.

6. POLICY ACKNOWLEDGEMENT
All employees are required to read the full Remote Work and Flexible Scheduling Policy document, available on the company intranet under HR Policies & Procedures, and sign the digital acknowledgement form no later than September 12, 2025. Failure to complete this step may result in the temporary suspension of remote work privileges until compliance is confirmed.

We believe these updates reflect our commitment to a productive, flexible, and collaborative work environment that supports both the needs of our clients and the well-being of our team. Questions or concerns regarding this policy should be directed to the Human Resources department at hr@marbledock-associates.internal or by contacting your direct supervisor.

Thank you for your continued dedication to Marbledock & Associates.

Warm regards,

Victoria L. Hargrove
Managing Director
Marbledock & Associates
September 3, 2025
